metadata.title: Egg curry northeastern style with MAGGI Masala-ae-Magic
metadata.description:
Welcome to our Northeast Indian kitchen! Today, we're making a mouth watering Egg and Tomatoes Curry using MAGGI Magic Ae Masala! This recipe is quick, simple, and packed with flavours that will leave you wanting more. Perfect for a hearty meal, this dish combines the richness of eggs with the tangy goodness of tomatoes, all enhanced by the magical taste of MAGGI Magic Ae Masala.

Ingredients:

4 eggs
3 ripe tomatoes
1 onion
2 green chilies
1 tablespoon MAGGI Magic Ae Masala
1 teaspoon turmeric powder
1 teaspoon red chili powder
Salt to taste
Fresh coriander leaves for garnish
2 tablespoons oil
Steps:

Boil the eggs, peel, and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped onions until golden brown.
Add green chilies and tomatoes, cooking until the tomatoes are soft.
Mix in turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt.
Stir in MAGGI Magic Ae Masala and cook for a few more minutes.
Add the boiled eggs to the curry and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with rice or roti.
Don't forget to like, share, and subscribe for more delicious recipes! Leave a comment below on how you liked this dish or any variations you tried.

Indulge in the rich flavours of homemade egg curry, elevated with  a dash of Maggi Masala-ae-Magic. A symphony of spices in every bite!
